scope: non-periodic direct Coulomb cutoff neighbor-list traversal
implementation: direct_coulomb_cutoff uses a uniform coordinate cell list for finite positive cutoffs and falls back to the previous all-pair path for invalid/non-finite inputs
interpretation: The cell-list result matches an independent all-pair reference on a fixture containing negative coordinates, cell boundaries, and out-of-cutoff pairs. This does not close periodic triclinic, long-range reciprocal, or full MMFF94 minimizer integration.
